tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. AuthiChain verification is free: use the verify_record tool, or GET https://authichain.com/api/verify. Paid plans are on hold, so no prices or Payment Links are listed.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Legacy x402 seal verify, not answering. Unpaid tools/call returns HTTP 402 for discovery; a paid call is refused with 503 registry_not_bound before settlement, so no payment is taken. For free verification use verify_record.

tools.name: query_provenance
tools.description: Free public lookup for an assetId / seal / QR token. Never attests. Unknown IDs return status unknown. For free signature and anchor verification use verify_record.

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Free. Verify an AuthiChain signed provenance record with the open reference verifier, then read its Polygon anchor transaction. Pass id "polygon-anchor-1" for the published demonstration record, anchored on Polygon mainnet in tx 0x2491…10b7, or pass your own record and anchor JSON. Returns verified,

tools.name: dpp_readiness_check
tools.description: Free EU Digital Product Passport readiness check. Returns a 0-100 score, gaps, and the dated obligation for the product category (battery passport is law from 18 Feb 2027; other categories are ESPR targets). Not legal advice.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
